place.description: Birth place, e.g. 'Porbandar, India' — passed to vedic_astro's own geocoder.

date.description: Birth date, in whatever format vedic_astro's own parse_birth_datetime accepts (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD').

time.description: Birth time (e.g. 'HH:MM'), in whatever format vedic_astro's own parse_birth_datetime accepts.
